description: The tab strip (V2-3.7, contract V2-3.7-own-tab-bar.md §8): the trusted app-local `strip.html` child webview across the top of the one `shell` window. `webviews` only, never the `shell` window, whose label every tab shares. No `remote`: it runs on the app-local origin only, and its navigation guard pins it to strip.html. Every tab command re-checks in Rust that the caller is the `strip` webview on the app-local strip.html (tabs::check_strip). The state reaches it through the Channel it hands `tabs_state`, never an event (an `Any` listener in a project page would hear an emit_to), so it needs no emit and no listen. `start-dragging` + `internal-toggle-maximize`: its empty areas are `data-tauri-drag-region` (drag the window, double-click to zoom).
